source: existing local Superset 4.1.3 with synthetic warehouse data; real authenticated HTTP requests

fresh_install.archive_origin: locally built candidate; earlier runs used a GitHub Actions artifact

reports.shared_context: same business request, owner-named dashboards and source helpers; both arms could read actual saved-chart rows

report_review.independent_review: Latest SignalWeave facts and arithmetic match the returned observations. The report explicitly distinguishes bucket deltas from complete, comparable business periods and does not invent a currency. The coverage flag is supplied by the connector, not a dashboard-certified source contract.
report_review.remaining_issue: Minor report wording should distinguish a connector-supplied coverage warning from a dashboard assertion and call an unspecified-currency net-sales value an amount, not physical units. One pair cannot establish a comparative quality or speed improvement.

latest_native_live_smoke.scope: Standalone smoke fixture, not the enterprise report trial.

product_repairs: Installer detects an older command shadowing the installed binary; README prepends the install directory in the current shell.
Agent registration scrubs OpenAI provider keys and key-file environment variables.
Skipped-source setup recommends adding a connection rather than a failing health check.
Superset pagination is encoded in the provider's query envelope; real five-item pages are distinct.
Temporal provenance preserves raw buckets and normalizes provider-declared temporal milliseconds to readable UTC ISO values.
Grouped non-additive or unknown metrics preserve separate series; duplicate non-additive buckets are not summed.
Bounded catalog browsing works without knowing dashboard titles; health rejects adapter-error pages.
Grouped additive metrics retain both the pooled total and per-dimension series, so compensating changes cannot hide a channel decline.
Raw bucket comparisons explicitly mark coverage unverified; the agent guide asks for the caveat beside the headline and warns against inventing currency.
Health output separates offline configuration checks from live catalog access without implying resource permissions or decision quality were validated.
PyJWT upgraded to 2.15.1; malformed nested-token parsing is regression-tested before network access.

test_suite.scope: full local checkout suite with required controlling-terminal permissions; includes local untracked historical evaluation tests
test_suite.claim: software regression coverage, not enterprise business accuracy

invalid_or_incomplete_runs_kept_separate: The first isolated registration attempt used a nonexistent CODEX_HOME; this was a harness error.
A first-report agent misconverted epoch dates before readable date provenance was added.
One candidate health run exposed an empty-query registry regression; the completed-onboarding claim was withheld.
A synthetic recurring cohort had totals inconsistent with its declared channel partition and incorrect legacy response-shape scoring.
A later recurring cohort blocked on synthetic channel-allocation provenance; it produced no future reports and is not business accuracy evidence.
One pilot had baseline tool-limit/timeout failures and a native transport error; its failure-inclusive utility difference is not a product improvement estimate.
Two later cohorts were stopped during onboarding because old fixture provenance remained in nested fields; their artifacts were preserved and no success was claimed.
remaining_proof: Improve consistency of historical-data disclosure in agent reports; the separate live-Jev recurring pilot completed four pairs, not an enterprise-quality pass.
Real human review of report usefulness beyond independent model review and rule-based proxies.
More independent business scenarios before a comparative improvement claim.
Publish a reviewed new preview before the improved source flow can become a one-line public download.
Actual human usability and customer validation; these scripted simulations are not either.
